description: Main CLI entry point for the openclaw project, handling command parsing, environment setup, plugin registration, and error handling.

methods.name: closeCliMemoryManagers
methods.description: Asynchronously closes active memory search managers if memory runtime is enabled.

methods.name: rewriteUpdateFlagArgv
methods.description: Replaces '--update' flag with 'update' in command-line arguments.

methods.name: shouldRegisterPrimarySubcommand
methods.description: Determines if the primary subcommand should be registered based on help/version flags.

methods.name: shouldSkipPluginCommandRegistration
methods.description: Decides whether to skip plugin CLI command registration based on current context.

methods.name: shouldEnsureCliPath
methods.description: Checks if the CLI path needs to be ensured based on command arguments.

methods.name: shouldUseRootHelpFastPath
methods.description: Determines if the fast path for root help should be used.

methods.name: resolveMissingBrowserCommandMessage
methods.description: Provides a message if the 'browser' command is unavailable due to plugin configuration.

methods.name: shouldLoadCliDotEnv
methods.description: Checks if a .env file should be loaded based on the current directory.

methods.name: runCli
methods.description: Main function to initialize and run the CLI, handling environment setup, command parsing, plugin registration, and error handling.

methods.name: isCliMainModule
methods.description: Checks if the current module is the main module executed.
